headline: XRP Ledger Bug Fix Delayed to November After Validator Dip
summary: The deployment of an XRP Ledger bug fix was postponed to November after validator support briefly dropped below the required threshold for two days before recovering.
why: The XRP Ledger is an enterprise-focused decentralized blockchain network associated with Ripple Labs.

impacts.name: XRP
impacts.why: Temporary delays in protocol updates highlight governance coordination challenges but do not fundamentally alter network operations.
